statements.dead:
SELECT q.id, q.attempts, COALESCE(q.last_error, ''),
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', q.updated_at),
  json_object('sku', q."sku", 'quantity', q."quantity"),
  count(*) OVER ()
FROM stock_checked_queue AS q
WHERE q.state = 'dead'
ORDER BY q.updated_at, q.id
LIMIT ?1
statements.states:
SELECT q.id, CASE WHEN q.id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sku ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM stock_checked_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = c.sku AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1) THEN '' WHEN q.state = 'dead' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = q.sku AND p.state = 'ready') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = q.sku AND p.id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sku ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM stock_checked_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = c.sku AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1))) THEN 'dead, and a ready message holds its key' ELSE q.state END
FROM stock_checked_queue AS q WHERE q.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
statements.retry:
UPDATE stock_checked_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sku ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM stock_checked_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = c.sku AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sku ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM stock_checked_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND c.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = c.sku AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1)) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id
statements.retryAll:
UPDATE stock_checked_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (
  SELECT c.id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.sku ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id) AS n
  FROM stock_checked_queue AS c WHERE c.state = 'dead' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stock_checked_queue AS p WHERE p.sku = c.sku AND p.state = 'ready')
) WHERE n = 1)
RETURNING id
statements.drop:
DELETE FROM stock_checked_queue
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM stock_checked_queue WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)))) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id
statements.dropAll:
DELETE FROM stock_checked_queue
WHERE state = 'dead'
RETURNING id
